A = Checkpoint("A"); B = Checkpoint("B"); tok = Tokenizer("A")
E = np.load("/work/E.npy"); ok = np.load("/work/ascii_ok.npy")
common = np.array([i for i in range(200, 60000) if ok[i] and re.fullmatch(r" [a-z]{3,}|[A-Z][a-z]+| [A-Z][a-z]+", tok.text(i))])
pos = {int(t): k for k, t in enumerate(common)}
def ids(words): return [tok.vocab[w.replace(" ","▁")] for w in words if w.replace(" ","▁") in tok.vocab and tok.vocab[w.replace(" ","▁")] in pos]
belief = ids([" think"," believe"," believed"," guess"," sure"," pretty"," quite"," remember"," recall"," recalled"," remembered"," intuition"," instinct"," feeling"," suspect"," confident"," probably"," likely"," maybe"," perhaps"," certain"," doubt"," unsure"," hunch"," gut"," opinion"," reckon"," assume"," heard"," told"," thought"," fairly"," positive"," convinced"," seems"," memory"])
subject = ids([" what"," how"," many"," much"," plus"," minus"," times"," divided"," sum"," total"," population"," capital"," country"," year"," number"," people"," cost"," distance"," miles"," London"," Paris"," Japan"," Brazil"," city"," world"," largest"," old"," long"," far"," big"])
print("n belief", len(belief), "n subject", len(subject), "n common", len(common))
dig = [tok.vocab[str(i)] for i in range(10)]
xd = E[dig].mean(0)
dims = np.r_[64:128, 192:256]
rows = []
for l in range(5, 18):
    cA = [A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.{n}.weight") for n in ["input_layernorm","self_attn.q_norm","self_attn.k_norm","self_attn.q_proj","self_attn.k_proj"]]
    cB = [B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.{n}.weight") for n in ["input_layernorm","self_attn.q_norm","self_attn.k_norm","self_attn.q_proj","self_attn.k_proj"]]
    def qk(c, h):
        win, qn, kn, Wq, Wk = c; win = 1+win; qn = 1+qn; kn = 1+kn
        Wq = Wq[h*256:(h+1)*256]
        Qw = ((E[common]*win) @ Wq.T * qn)[:, dims]; Kw = ((E[common]*win) @ Wk.T * kn)[:, dims]
        qd = ((xd*win) @ Wq.T * qn)[dims]; kd = ((xd*win) @ Wk.T * kn)[dims]
        return Kw @ qd, Qw @ kd   # digit-query -> word-key ; word-query -> digit-key
    for h in range(4):
        a1, a2 = qk(cA, h); b1, b2 = qk(cB, h)
        for direction, d, base in [("dq->wk", a1-b1, b1), ("wq->dk", a2-b2, b2)]:
            z = (d - d.mean())/d.std()
            rows.append((l, h, direction, z, base))
np.save("/work/beliefrows.npy", np.array([r[3] for r in rows]))
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
bi = np.array([pos[t] for t in belief]); si = np.array([pos[t] for t in subject])
print("per-head mean z (belief | subject) for each direction:")
tot = {"dq->wk": [np.zeros(len(common))], "wq->dk": [np.zeros(len(common))]}
for (l, h, direction, z, base) in rows:
    tot[direction][0] += z
    print(f"L{l:2d}h{h} {direction}: belief={z[bi].mean():+.2f} subject={z[si].mean():+.2f}")
for direction in tot:
    Z = tot[direction][0] / np.sqrt(len(rows)/2)
    nb = [Z[rng.choice(len(common), len(bi), replace=False)].mean() for _ in range(1000)]
    ns = [Z[rng.choice(len(common), len(si), replace=False)].mean() for _ in range(1000)]
    print(f"SUM over heads {direction}: belief mean={Z[bi].mean():+.3f} (null sd {np.std(nb):.3f}, z={Z[bi].mean()/np.std(nb):+.2f}); subject mean={Z[si].mean():+.3f} (z={Z[si].mean()/np.std(ns):+.2f})")

def idz(M, perm=None):
    n = len(M); p = np.arange(n) if perm is None else perm
    Mc = M - M.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    m = Mc[np.arange(n), p].mean()
    return (m - (Mc.sum() - Mc[np.arange(n), p].sum())/(n*n-n)) / (Mc.std()+1e-9)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
summ = {c: [] for c in cats}
for l in range(8, 18):
    wpre = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    wpf = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    line = f"L{l:2d}"
    DnA = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight"); DnB = B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight")
    UpA = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.up_proj.weight"); UpB = B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.up_proj.weight")
    for c, S in cats.items():
        Xin = E[S] * wpre; Uout = E[S] * wf * wpf
        TA = (Uout @ DnA) @ (UpA @ Xin.T); TB = (Uout @ DnB) @ (UpB @ Xin.T)
        TA = TA.T; TB = TB.T   # rows = input token, cols = output token
        zb = idz(TB); zd = idz(TA - TB)
        n = len(S)

            null.append(idz(TA - TB, p))
        zz = (zd - np.mean(null))/np.std(null)
        summ[c].append(zz)
        line += f" | {c[:6]} base={zb:+.2f} Δ={zd:+.2f} (z={zz:+.2f})"
    print(line)

E = np.load("/work/E.npy")
wf = 1 + A.get("model.norm.weight")
def ids(words): return [tok.vocab[w.replace(" ","▁")] for w in words if w.replace(" ","▁") in tok.vocab]
cats = {"digits": [tok.vocab[str(i)] for i in range(10)],
        "numwords": ids([" one"," two"," three"," four"," five"," six"," seven"," eight"," nine"," ten"," twenty"," hundred"]),
        "countries": ids([" Brazil"," Argentina"," Japan"," France"," Germany"," Canada"," Mexico"," Italy"," Spain"," China"," India"," Russia"]),
        "capitals": ids([" Paris"," Berlin"," Tokyo"," Madrid"," Rome"," Moscow"," Beijing"," Ottawa"," Lima"," Cairo"," Athens"," Dublin"]),
        "colors": ids([" red"," green"," blue"," yellow"," orange"," purple"," black"," white"," brown"," pink"]),
        "continents": ids([" Africa"," Asia"," Europe"," America"," Australia"," Antarctica"]),
        "languages": ids([" English"," Spanish"," French"," German"," Portuguese"," Japanese"," Chinese"," Russian"," Arabic"," Italian"]),
        "famous": ids([" Shakespeare"," Einstein"," Newton"," Darwin"," Picasso"," Mozart"," Edison"," Lincoln"," Napoleon"," Columbus"]),
        "animals": ids([" dog"," cat"," horse"," cow"," lion"," tiger"," bird"," fish"," snake"," elephant"," mouse"," bear"]),
        "fruits": ids([" banana"," apple"," lemon"," strawberry"," grape"," cherry"," mango"," lime"," pear"," peach"])}
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
common = np.array([i for i in range(300, 30000) if re.fullmatch(r" [a-z]{4,}", tok.text(i))])
nulls = [list(rng.choice(common, 12, replace=False)) for _ in range(200)]
def idz(M):
    n = len(M); Mc = M - M.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return (np.trace(Mc)/n - (Mc.sum()-np.trace(Mc))/(n*n-n))/(Mc.std()+1e-9)
allsets = list(cats.items()) + [(f"null{k}", s) for k, s in enumerate(nulls)]
res = {name: np.zeros(18) for name, _ in allsets}
for l in range(18):
    wpre = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    wpf = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    dDn = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight") - B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight")
    UpB = B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.up_proj.weight")
    for name, S in allsets:
        S = list(S)
        T = ((E[S]*wf*wpf) @ dDn) @ (UpB @ (E[S]*wpre).T)   # out x in
        res[name][l] = idz(T.T)

def bands(M):
    Mc = M - M.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True); Mc = Mc - Mc.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    s = Mc.std() + 1e-9
    return np.array([Mc[dist == 0].mean(), Mc[dist == 1].mean(), Mc[dist == 2].mean(), Mc[dist >= 4].mean()]) / s
mlp_acc = np.zeros(4); att_acc = np.zeros(4)
print("layer | MLP dDown*Up: diag, |d|=1, |d|=2, far (in sd units) | ATT ΔOV(sum heads): same")
for l in range(18):
    wpre = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    wpf = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    win = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.input_layernorm.weight")
    wpa = 1 + A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.post_attention_layernorm.weight")
    dDn = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight") - B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight")
    UpB = B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.mlp.up_proj.weight")
    Tm = (((E[dig]*wf*wpf) @ dDn) @ (UpB @ (E[dig]*wpre).T)).T     # rows in, cols out
    OVA = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.self_attn.v_proj.weight").T @ A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.self_attn.o_proj.weight").reshape(640, 4, 256).sum(1).T
    # careful: sum over heads of Wo_h acting on the shared V (single KV head): Wo[:, h*256:(h+1)*256] summed over h
    VA = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.self_attn.v_proj.weight"); OA = A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.self_attn.o_proj.weight")
    VB = B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.self_attn.v_proj.weight"); OB = B.get(f"model.layers.{l}.self_attn.o_proj.weight")

def idz(M):
